paite: Tuikulh gamte aw, ka ma ah dai sipsip unla; michih in ahatna uh thaksak nawn uhenla; hong pai nai chiat le uh; huai khit chiang in gen uhen; vaihawm ding in paikhawm ni.
heading: Israel Kiang A Pathian Kichiamna
english: “Keep silent before me, islands, and let the peoples renew their strength. Let them come near, then let them speak. Let’s meet together for judgment.

paite: Suahlam a kipan mi khat, diktatna ziak a akhebul a asap, kua'n ahia kaihalh? Ama'n ama ah namte apia a, kumpipate tung ah vai ahawmsak a; leivui bang in anamsau kiang ah apia a, buhsi huih mutleng bang in athalpeu kiang ah leng apia hi.
english: Who has raised up one from the east? Who called him to his foot in righteousness? He hands over nations to him, and makes him rule over kings. He gives them like the dust to his sword, like the driven stubble to his bow.

paite: Ama'n amaute adelh a, bittak in араі а; akhe a apai nailouhna lampi ah.
english: He pursues them, and passes by safely, Even by a way that he had not gone with his feet.

paite: Atung a kipan suan tengteng sam in, kua'n ahia sem a, hih khin? Kei TOUPA, amasapen leh ananungpen, ahihpa kei kia ka hi.
english: Who has worked and done it, calling the generations from the beginning? I, Yahweh, the first, and with the last, I am he.”

paite: Tuikulh gamte'n amu ua; alau ua; kawlmongte aling ua; ahon naih a, ahong pai uhi.
english: The islands have seen, and fear. The ends of the earth tremble. They approach, and come.

paite: Michih in amau lawmte apanpih ua; michih in a-unaute uh kiang ah, Khamuangtak in om un, achi chiat uhi.
english: Everyone helps his neighbor. They say to their brothers, “Be strong!”

paite: Huchi in abulhkipna lam thu ah, "Ahoih hi,” chi in khutsiam mi in dangka-eng sekmi ahanthawn a, sek a sekmum mi in sekdou sekmi a ahanthawn; alinlouhna ding in kilhnate in akilh kipta hi.
english: So the carpenter encourages the goldsmith. He who smoothes with the hammer encourages him who strikes the anvil, saying of the soldering, “It is good”; and he fastens it with nails, that it might not totter.

paite: Himahleh nou Israelte ka sikha, Jakobte ka mitel, ka lawm, Abraham suante aw,
english: “But you, Israel, my servant, Jacob whom I have chosen, the seed of Abraham my friend,

paite: Nou, lei tawpna a kipan a ka mipi, anawl a kipan a ka misap, "Ка sikhate na hi ua, hon paikhe lou in ka hon tel zaw," ka hon chihte aw,
english: You whom I have taken hold of from the ends of the earth, and called from its corners, and said to you, ‘You are my servant, I have chosen you and not cast you away;’

paite: Lau kei un, kei lah na kiang uah ka om ngal a; mangbang kei un, kei lah na Pathian uh ka hi ngal a; ka hon hatsak ding a; ahi, ka hon panpih ding; ahi, ka diktatna khut taklam in ka hon len gige ding hi.
english: Don’t you be afraid, for I am with you. Don’t be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you. Yes, I will help you. Yes, I will uphold you with the right hand of my righteousness.

paite: Ngai in, na tung ua lungkim lou tengteng zahlaktak leh zumtak in a-om ding uh; nou hon selte lah bangmah lou bang ahi ding ua, amang ding uh.
english: Behold, all those who are incensed against you will be disappointed and confounded. Those who strive with you will be like nothing, and shall perish.

paite: Nou hon selte na zong ding ua, na mu tuan kei ding uh; nou hon doute lah bangmah lou bang ahi ding ua, thil om lou bang lel ahi ding uh.
english: You will seek them, and won’t find them, even those who contend with you. Those who war against you will be as nothing, as a non-existent thing.

paite: Kei TOUPA na Pathian un, Lau kei un, ka hon panpih ding, chi in na khut taklam uh ka len ding hi.
english: For I, Yahweh your God, will hold your right hand, saying to you, ‘Don’t be afraid. I will help you.’

paite: Nou Jakob tangtel leh Israel mite aw, lau kei un, ka hon panpih ding, TOUPA'N achi, nou hon tanpa Israelte Mi Siangthou ahi.
english: Don’t be afraid, you worm Jacob, and you men of Israel. I will help you,” says Yahweh, “and your Redeemer is the Holy One of Israel.

paite: Ngai in, buhsukna khawl thak mahmah, hiam mahmah, ha nei in ka hon bawl ding; tangte chil in na khenzan ding ua, mualte buhsi bang in na bawl ding uh.
english: Behold, I have made you into a new sharp threshing instrument with teeth. You will thresh the mountains, and beat them small, and will make the hills like chaff.

paite: Na zap ding ua, huih in amut leng ding, pingpei in ahihdalh ding a, huan, noute TOUPA ah na kipak ding ua, Israelte Mi Siangthou na hon suang ding uh.
english: You will winnow them, and the wind will carry them away, and the whirlwind will scatter them. You will rejoice in Yahweh. You will glory in the Holy One of Israel.

paite: Migenthei leh tagahte'n tui azong ua, a-om kei a, alei uh dangtak in ahul khin hi; kei TOUPA'N amau ka dawng ding a, kei Israel' Pathian in amau ka paisan kei ding.
english: The poor and needy seek water, and there is none. Their tongue fails for thirst. I, Yahweh, will answer them. I, the God of Israel, will not forsake them.

paite: Tang sang giau ah luite ka luangsak ding a, phaizang laizangte ah tui nak ka suaksak ding; gamdai dil in ka bawl ding a, gamkeu leng tui nak in ka bawl ding hi.
english: I will open rivers on the bare heights, and springs in the midst of the valleys. I will make the wilderness a pool of water, and the dry land springs of water.

paite: Gamdai ah sidar singte, singgite, muite, thausingte ka suan ding a, gamkeu ah meilah singte, phante, sing gelh chite ka suankhawm vek ding;
english: I will put cedar, acacia, myrtle, and oil trees in the wilderness. I will set fir trees, pine, and box trees together in the desert;

paite: TOUPA khut in huaite ahih ahi chih leh Israelte Mi Siangthou in asiam ahi chih amuh ua, atheih ua, angaihtuah ua, atheihsiam theihna ding un.
english: that they may see, know, consider, and understand together, that the hand of Yahweh has done this, and the Holy One of Israel has created it.

paite: Na thu uh hong gen un, TOUPA'N achi; na paulam pen uh langsak un, Jakobte' Kumpipa'n achi hi.
heading: Toupa'n Pathian Takloute Achouna
english: Produce your cause,” says Yahweh. “Bring forth your strong reasons,” says the King of Jacob.

paite: Huaite langsak uhenla, thil hong tung dingte i kiang uah gen uhen; i ngaihtuah theihna ding leh atawpna ding i theihtheihna ding in, tuma thilte bang ahia gen un; ahihkeileh, thil hong tung dingte hon theisak un.
english: “Let them announce, and declare to us what shall happen. Declare the former things, what they are, that we may consider them, and know the latter end of them; or show us things to come.

paite: pathiante na hi uh chih ka theihna ding un tunung chiang a thil tung dingte gen un; ahi, i mangbat chiatna ding un leh i et chiat ding un thil hoih thiam thil hoih lou hiam hih dih ua le.
english: Declare the things that are to come hereafter, that we may know that you are gods. Yes, do good, or do evil, that we may be dismayed, and see it together.

paite: Ngai un, bangmah na hi kei ua, na thilhih uh leng bangmah ahi kei; nou hon telpa mikihhuai ahi.
english: Behold, you are of nothing, and your work is of nothing. He who chooses you is an abomination.

paite: Mallam a kipan mi khat ka dingsak a, amah ahong tung a; nisuahna a kipan ka min loupa; ama'n suang bulhkipna abawl bang in vaihawmte abawl ding a, belvelmi'n bellei achil bang in achil ding hi.
english: “I have raised up one from the north, and he has come; from the rising of the sun, one who calls on my name; and he shall come on rulers as on mortar, and as the potter treads clay.

paite: I theihtheihna ding un kua'n ahia atung a kipan gen ngei? Amah zaw adik i chih theihna ding un kua'n ahia genkhol ngei? Ahi gen himhim a-om kei uh, ahi, theisak himhim a-om kei uh, ahi, na thugente uh za a-om kei uh.
english: Who has declared it from the beginning, that we may know? And before, that we may say, ‘He is right?’ Surely, there is no one who declares. Surely, there is no one who shows. Surely, there is no one who hears your words.

paite: Ke'n Zion kiang ah, "En in, hiai ah amaute a-om uh," chi masa ding ka hi a, Jerusalem kiang ah tanchinhoih hon tun mi khat ka pe ding.
english: I am the first to say to Zion, ‘Behold, look at them;’ and I will give one who brings good news to Jerusalem.

paite: Ka et in leng mi himhim a-om kei ua; amau ka dot in leng, alak ua lemthei mi, thu khat leng dawng thei, kuamah himhim leng a-om kei uh.
english: When I look, there is no man; even among them there is no counselor who, when I ask of them, can answer a word.

paite: En un, anasepte uh bangmah lou ahi a, thil om lou ahi; amilim sunte uh lah huih leh huihkhua lel ahi.
english: Behold, all of them, their works are vanity and nothing. Their molten images are wind and confusion.
